m: Take the steaks out of the fridge 45 minutes before cooking and salt them well. Room-temperature steak cooks evenly.
Potatoes: oven to 220°C. Halve small potatoes, boil 10 minutes, drain, then crush lightly on an oiled tray with chopped rosemary and salt. Roast 35 minutes until deep golden.
Chimichurri: finely chop the parsley and garlic, mix with the chilli flakes, oregano, vinegar, a pinch of salt and enough oil to loosen (about 3 tbsp per 2 serves). Leave it to sit while you cook.
Get a heavy pan smoking hot. Sear the steaks 3 to 4 minutes a side for medium-rare, turning once.
In the last minute add the butter and a sprig of rosemary, and spoon the foaming butter over the steaks. Rest 8 minutes on a board. Don't skip this.
Blister the beans in the same pan for 3 minutes with a squeeze of lemon.
Slice the steak against the grain, spoon over the chimichurri, and serve with the potatoes and beans.
l: Slice the steak thin and pack over the potatoes and beans, chimichurri in a little container. Great cold or barely warm.
